title: A Net, a Lineage and a Mouse That Cannot Say

scenes.tts: A mouse cannot say a touch feels nice. Which of its cells detect a stroke, and what can we measure?
scenes.visual: Title card: A Net, a Lineage and a Mouse That Cannot Say. A mouse on a soft surface, a brush above its back. Question on screen: which cells, and what outcome?
scenes.narration: A mouse cannot say a touch feels nice. Which of its cells detect a stroke, and what can we measure?

scenes.tts: In mouse hairy skin, at least three afferent classes are candidates for detecting a stroke.
scenes.visual: Three labelled slots appear beside a hair follicle.
scenes.narration: In mouse hairy skin, at least three afferent classes are candidates for detecting a stroke.

scenes.tts: First, unmyelinated touch afferents marked by tyrosine hydroxylase. Their endings run lengthwise along a hair follicle.
scenes.visual: A follicle with thin lanceolate endings running along it. Label: TH-positive C-LTMRs, lanceolate endings.
scenes.narration: First, unmyelinated touch afferents marked by tyrosine hydroxylase. Their endings run lengthwise along a hair follicle.

scenes.tts: Second, unmyelinated neurons marked by a receptor called M R G P R B four. Their fibres innervate hairy skin only.
scenes.caption: Second, unmyelinated neurons marked by a receptor called MrgprB4. Their fibres innervate hairy skin only.
scenes.visual: A second set of thin fibres in a different colour. Label: MrgprB4 neurons, hairy skin only.
scenes.narration: Second, unmyelinated neurons marked by a receptor called MrgprB4. Their fibres innervate hairy skin only.

scenes.tts: Third, A beta field afferents. They are myelinated, and their endings wrap around the follicle.
scenes.caption: Third, Aβ field afferents. They are myelinated, and their endings wrap around the follicle.
scenes.visual: A thicker fibre whose endings circle the follicle. Label: Aβ field-LTMRs, circumferential endings.
scenes.narration: Third, Aβ field afferents. They are myelinated, and their endings wrap around the follicle.

scenes.tts: A field afferent ignores any single hair. Indenting the skin drives it only at high force.
scenes.visual: One hair bends; the field-LTMR's spike trace stays flat. A probe presses the skin; nothing until a high force. Label: high indentation threshold.
scenes.narration: A field afferent ignores any single hair. Indenting the skin drives it only at high force.

scenes.tts: But one neuron can form as many as one hundred eighty endings, around many follicles.
scenes.caption: But one neuron can form as many as 180 endings, around many follicles.
scenes.visual: Zoom out: one field-LTMR axon branches to many follicles. Label: up to 180 endings.
scenes.narration: But one neuron can form as many as 180 endings, around many follicles.

scenes.tts: Predict. What does a gentle stroke across the skin do to this neuron?
scenes.visual: A brush poised over the field of follicles. Text: predict.
scenes.narration: Predict. What does a gentle stroke across the skin do to this neuron?

scenes.tts: It fires. The authors proposed that it sums many weakly sensitive endings.
scenes.visual: The brush sweeps across many follicles at once; the spike trace fires. Label: summation across endings (proposed).
scenes.narration: It fires. The authors proposed that it sums many weakly sensitive endings.

scenes.tts: A single hair is a lever. A field afferent is a net.
scenes.visual: Caption card: a single hair is a lever; a field-LTMR is a net.
scenes.narration: A single hair is a lever. A field afferent is a net.

scenes.tts: Now the outcomes. Activating M R G P R B four neurons gave young male mice a place preference.
scenes.caption: Now the outcomes. Activating MrgprB4 neurons gave young male mice a place preference.
scenes.visual: A two-chamber box; the mouse spends more time on the side paired with activation. Label: Vrontou and colleagues, 2013; males about one month old.
scenes.narration: Now the outcomes. Activating MrgprB4 neurons gave young male mice a place preference.

scenes.tts: The authors read this as positive reinforcement, reduced anxiety, or both.
scenes.visual: Two labels beside the box: reinforcement? reduced anxiety? Both kept open.
scenes.narration: The authors read this as positive reinforcement, reduced anxiety, or both.

scenes.tts: Adult females whose lineage of these cells was removed during development were less sexually receptive.
scenes.visual: A female mouse; a lineage label greys out. Label: Elias and colleagues, 2023; developmental ablation, adult testing; receptivity lower.
scenes.narration: Adult females whose lineage of these cells was removed during development were less sexually receptive.

scenes.tts: A permanent genetic label marks neurons that once expressed the gene, including some that no longer do in adults.
scenes.visual: The same group of neurons at an early and an adult time point: the reporter label stays on in all of them, while current Mrgprb4 expression turns off in some.
scenes.narration: A permanent genetic label marks neurons that once expressed the gene, including some that no longer do in adults.

scenes.tts: And a dopamine-sensor signal in the nucleus accumbens was reduced during mounting.
scenes.visual: A fibre-photometry trace from the nucleus accumbens, smaller in ablated females than controls.
scenes.narration: And a dopamine-sensor signal in the nucleus accumbens was reduced during mounting.

scenes.tts: A chamber preference, a mating behaviour, a dopamine signal. Each is an outcome, not a feeling.
scenes.visual: Three readout icons in a row: place preference box, receptivity, accumbens dopamine trace, each labelled outcome. The word feeling is struck through.
scenes.narration: A chamber preference, a mating behaviour, a dopamine signal. Each is an outcome, not a feeling.

scenes.tts: Back to the one idea. In people, one fibre has a caress-shaped curve that pleasantness follows.
scenes.visual: End card: the CT inverted U with the ratings curve over it.
scenes.narration: Back to the one idea. In people, one fibre has a caress-shaped curve that pleasantness follows.

scenes.tts: Which mouse cell, if any, matches that human fibre is still unsettled.
scenes.visual: End card adds the open question: which mouse cell is the human CT afferent?
scenes.narration: Which mouse cell, if any, matches that human fibre is still unsettled.

scenes.tts: Keep the human candidate and the mouse outcomes apart until a match is made.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: human candidate, mouse outcomes, kept apart until matched.
scenes.narration: Keep the human candidate and the mouse outcomes apart until a match is made.
